cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Recognize Me
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge your importance, expertise, or authority.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The bridge opening may proceed once you've acknowledged who kept it out of the river.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can I thank the whole engineering team?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Collective thanks are approved. You may then identify its leader.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've got your name on the plaque. Can we cut the ribbon?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The plaque is satisfactory. You may read my name aloud while I hold the scissors; then I'll release them.
